entries.name: Landes-Thorax Klythesias
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE full-body THORAX country-warrior cutout for Aleria's Klythesia, no named person, house, new rank or invented guard order. Reference 1 defines ONLY the approved matte hand-painted art style: readable simplified shapes, thin softly painted contours, fine even gouache pigment grain, muted bronze/steel/fabrics, restrained shading, not realism or CGI. Reference 2 defines ONLY the THORAX class: female Greek Amazon, functional torso armor, large round HOPLON and one straight DORY SPEAR, open ATHENIAN/ATTIC helmet. Reference 3 defines the exact COUNTRY HERALDRY, faithfully paint it on the hoplon: one blue-to-turquoise S-curved snake with red eye and little red forked tongue over the red-and-ivory striped field, concentric red/ivory/blue bands and a narrow bronze rim. Do not add extra snakes, heads, wings or letter S.
Subject: ONE attractive athletic young ADULT woman around27 with olive skin, short dark wavy hair tied back and calm alert expression, ordinary rounded human ears. An independent relaxed three-quarter standing pose, weight on rear leg and front sandal slightly advanced, not the exact stance of the prototype. Bright but matte pale-steel Greek solid cuirass with narrow bronze bands and small articulated shoulder guards, navy short Greek chiton with practical short leather pteryges, a short red shoulder mantle pinned close, bronze wrist bracers and fitted greaves, bare upper arms and mobile thighs, fully clothed groin and buttocks, no lingerie or sexual posing. Her open ATTIC/Athenian bronze helmet has cheekpieces, a blue-and-ivory horsehair crest and no closed face mask. Left forearm securely carries a great round HOPLON angled gently outward with the exact S-snake country sign clearly visible on its face. Right hand firmly grips a perfectly STRAIGHT ashwood DORY spear inclined a little outward away from the body, coherent shaft from steel leaf tip to bronze butt. Spear a practical compact length so BOTH tips fit comfortably inside the image. No sword, bow, new heraldic animal or symbols. Secure compact mantle and straps suggest practical travel through wooded coasts and islands but there is NO scenery.
1024x1536 portrait, complete figure from highest crest through BOTH full sandal soles and ALL weapon ends. Keep at least 60px completely empty space above the spear point and below the feet and 40px at sides; scale the whole composition down slightly if needed. True transparent background INCLUDING all open gaps, no scenery, floor, cast shadow, glow, haze, background rectangle, text, watermark, western knight helmet, animal skull helmet or modern weapons.
